what.text: This page follows asylum seekers from Saint Kitts and Nevis in all host countries: people who have asked for international protection and are waiting for a decision.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 64 asylum seekers from Saint Kitts and Nevis, and the United Kingdom hosted 54.7% of them.
After the United Kingdom, the largest hosts are Canada and Spain.

why.text: The fact pack records no armed conflict and no dated events for Saint Kitts and Nevis, so it does not say why people left.
The main years of displacement in the data are 2023 to 2025.

when.text: UNHCR's series starts in 2000 at 5 asylum seekers.
The figure was at its highest, 81, at the end of 2024, and was lower at the end of 2025.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took.
These are year-end totals summed over every host country that reported to UNHCR.
